name: Minimum out-of-sample sample size
threshold: n >= 300 final games in the locked 2026 holdout
rationale: Small samples let favorable variance masquerade as skill; NIST notes proportion tests need large N.
threshold_type: PROJECT-DEFINED — not an official NFL value

name: Walk-forward, no leakage
threshold: Every prediction uses only games with kickoff strictly before that game
rationale: Prevents future standings/results from leaking into historical signals.
threshold_type: PROJECT-DEFINED — not an official NFL value

name: Probability calibration
threshold: Brier score lower than the 0.25 constant-0.5 baseline; 95% bootstrap CI for improvement excludes 0
rationale: A useful own line must be better calibrated than a coin flip.
threshold_type: PROJECT-DEFINED — not an official NFL value

name: Winner discrimination
threshold: One-sided exact binomial p < 0.05 against p0 = 0.5
rationale: Winner accuracy alone is noisy; an exact binomial test bounds luck.
threshold_type: PROJECT-DEFINED — not an official NFL value

name: Luck-adjusted skill
threshold: Lower 95% bootstrap bound of (baseline log loss - model log loss) > 0
rationale: Requires the improvement to survive resampling rather than a lucky run.
threshold_type: PROJECT-DEFINED — not an official NFL value

name: Multiple-testing control
threshold: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR q < 0.05 across all evaluated strategies
rationale: A leaderboard with many strategies will produce false winners by chance.
threshold_type: PROJECT-DEFINED — not an official NFL value

name: Temporal stability
threshold: Positive skill score in both halves of the holdout
rationale: A signal that only works in one half is not selectively skill-based.
threshold_type: PROJECT-DEFINED — not an official NFL value

name: Dependence / correlation control
threshold: Measured same-week leg phi reported; joint price uses dependence, never an independence assumption
rationale: Parlays and same-game prop combos are invalid if legs are correlated but priced as independent.
threshold_type: PROJECT-DEFINED — not an official NFL value

name: Official price archive
threshold: Verified timestamped market/closing prices must exist before ROI or CLV claims
rationale: No official NFL source publishes betting lines; market edge cannot be measured without prices.
threshold_type: PROJECT-DEFINED — not an official NFL value

name: Prospective replication
threshold: At least one locked, pre-registered future slate settled after model lock
rationale: Backtests cannot remove luck without prospective out-of-sample replication.
threshold_type: PROJECT-DEFINED — not an official NFL value

name: Player-prop game logs
threshold: Official game-by-game player logs and prop settlement rules must exist before combo validation
rationale: Season aggregates cannot validate a player-prop combination.
threshold_type: PROJECT-DEFINED — not an official NFL value

name: Funded reward pool
threshold: An official reward definition must exist before points are awarded
rationale: Leaderboard rewards are not verifiable without a defined prize pool.
threshold_type: PROJECT-DEFINED — not an official NFL value
